Run the STAMPED probes over a checked-out research object.

    run_probes.py <path> [-o probes.json] [--response response.json]
                  [--only NAME ...] [--skip NAME ...] [--check-remote]
                  [--kind dataset|component|study|skill]

Writes the per-probe results, and optionally a response JSON (the format in
``../stamped-conventions/references/response-format.md``) in which every item a
probe speaks to carries that probe's verdict and every other item is left
``not-checked`` for the assessing session to judge.

The probes never modify the object.  Nothing here replaces the judgement items:
a response straight out of this script is a draft, not an assessment.

positional arguments:
  path                  checked-out object to probe

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT   write the probe results here
  --response RESPONSE   also write a draft response JSON here
  --only {ci-present,clone-weight,derived-have-records,entry-point,env-spec-tracked,inputs-untouched,large-in-annex,license-declared,modules-separated,no-abs-paths,platform-assumptions,run-env-linked,subdatasets-resolvable,tree-clean} [{ci-present,clone-weight,derived-have-records,entry-point,env-spec-tracked,inputs-untouched,large-in-annex,license-declared,modules-separated,no-abs-paths,platform-assumptions,run-env-linked,subdatasets-resolvable,tree-clean} ...]
                        run just these probes
  --skip {ci-present,clone-weight,derived-have-records,entry-point,env-spec-tracked,inputs-untouched,large-in-annex,license-declared,modules-separated,no-abs-paths,platform-assumptions,run-env-linked,subdatasets-resolvable,tree-clean} [{ci-present,clone-weight,derived-have-records,entry-point,env-spec-tracked,inputs-untouched,large-in-annex,license-declared,modules-separated,no-abs-paths,platform-assumptions,run-env-linked,subdatasets-resolvable,tree-clean} ...]

  --kind {dataset,component,study,skill}
  --overwrite           replace an existing --response file instead of keeping
